name: English
title: Mind Cipher — a Mastermind puzzle filed as a spy dossier
description: Guess the hidden color code on iPhone. Every analysis comes back as ink marks: dot, ring, dash. In the Lie file one report is fake. 480 cases, Today's Case, Duel. Free to start, no ads.
og_description: Guess the code. One of the reports is lying.
h1:
Guess the code.
One report is lying.
lede: A Mastermind-style code-breaking puzzle for iPhone, filed as a spy dossier. Every analysis comes back as a row of ink marks — and in the Lie file, exactly one report is fake.
cta: Get it on the App Store
terms: Free to start · $2.99 unlocks everything · No ads · No account
board_row1_sr: Reported: all four not in the code.
board_row2_sr: Reported: two exact, two in the wrong slot.
board_row3_sr: Reported: one exact, one in the wrong slot, two not in the code.
board_note: Rows I and II use the same four colors. Row I says none of them are in the code; row II says all four are. Both cannot be true — one of these reports is fake.
round_h2: A Lie case, opened to closed.
step1_p: Pick colors into the slots and submit the analysis. Cases run from 4 pegs and 6 colors up to longer codes with 8.
step1_aria: A six-color palette, two pegs already placed, two empty slots left
step2_p: Each submitted row comes back with four ink marks. The marks never say which peg they refer to. That gap is the puzzle.
legend_miss: not in the code at all
step2_aria: A guess of colors 1 2 3 4 comes back as one dot, one ring, two dashes
step2_note: Two of these four colors are in the code — if this report is honest. In a Lie case you still have to prove that.
step3_p: One row in every Lie case is fake, so a clean deduction can still walk you into a wall. Find the two rows that cannot both be true, throw the bad one out, and rebuild from what is left.
step3_fig: A pair that cannot both be true
step3_aria: Two rows using the same four colors with opposite reports, so one must be fake
step3_note: Row I says none of these colors are in the code. Row II says all four are. One of those reports is fake.
shot1_alt: A Mind Cipher case in progress: Challenge No. 0908 on cream paper, two analyzed rows of numbered color seals with dot, ring and dash marks beside each, an evidence tray and the color palette below.
shot1_p: 240 cases from beginner to master, each a numbered sheet in the file. The attempt counter sits top-right; the marks are pure ink — dot, ring, dash — so they never depend on color.
shot1_n1: Every past analysis stays on the sheet for cross-referencing.
shot1_n2: Notes on the board mark eliminated and confirmed colors.
shot1_n3: A Shape Marks setting gives every color its own outline.
shot2_alt: A Lie case in Mind Cipher: the same board with a red stamp warning that one report in this case is fake.
shot2_p: A separate 240-case file. Same boards, one faked report per case, and a red stamp that reminds you not to trust the page.
shot2_n1: Only one row per case is faked — never two.
shot2_n2: Attempt budgets are looser here, because you will burn analyses proving a lie.
shot3_alt: Today's Case in Mind Cipher: a streak ledger, a calendar with closed days stamped, and today's puzzle settings.
shot3_p: One puzzle a day, identical for everybody. The settings are published before you start — code length, color count, attempt budget, whether repeats are allowed. Top Secret days are lie cases.
shot3_n1: Streak and total are kept in a ledger on the device.
shot3_n2: Closed days stay stamped on the calendar; a home-screen widget shows today's status.
sheet_caption: Mind Cipher modes and what each one costs
row_daily_d: One shared puzzle per day, with a streak ledger and a widget.
row_classic_d: 240 cases, beginner to master, honest marks.
row_lie_d: 240 cases where one report per case is fake.
row_duel_d: Pass one phone back and forth. One sets a code, one cracks it.
row_challenge_d: Send a case you closed as a link. They get the same code.
row_free_d: Endless generated boards at any difficulty you set.
row_editor_d: Build your own board — length, colors, attempts, repeats.
sheet_foot: Pro is $2.99 once. It opens the remaining 360 cases, Free Play and the editor. No subscription, no ads, no account, and progress never leaves the device. Two themes — Dossier and Night Desk — and the app follows your language or the one you set in Settings.
closer_line:
Logic is your only weapon.
One report is lying.
dock_line: iPhone · free to start · $2.99 unlocks everything
